pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous dark brown polygons characterized by irregular, serrated edges and high-contrast boundaries. Patch size decreases from the mid-flank toward the lower neck and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned topological graph of varying pixel width separating the dark patches. The network features continuous pathways with clearly defined tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark brown mane along the upper neck edge displaying a jagged, high-frequency 1D contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the mid-dorsal ridge, creating a localized textural and color anomaly.
